Speaking

Three parts, three different rhythms. Say your answers out loud — reading them silently trains nothing.

Part 1 — Introduction

  • 4–5 minutes, familiar topics
  • Answer in 2–3 sentences, never one word
  • Add a reason or example unprompted

Part 2 — Long turn

  • 1 minute prep, speak 1–2 minutes
  • Cover every bullet on the card
  • Use the prep minute for keywords, not sentences

Part 3 — Discussion

  • 4–5 minutes, abstract questions
  • Compare, speculate, weigh both sides
  • Thinking aloud is allowed and sounds natural
